          <Badge label="Engineering" />

        </HStack>
      </VStack>
      <VStack gap={2}>
        <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
          HAlign: between
        </Text>
        <HStack gap={2} hAlign="between">
          <Badge label="Start" />
          <Badge label="Middle" />
          <Badge label="End" />
        </HStack>
      </VStack>
    </VStack>
  );
}
